chat_history.content: Who are the directors of the top 5 highest-grossing films?

content.content: The user asks: "Who are the directors of the top 5 highest-grossing films?" They likely want a list of directors for the top 5 highest-grossing movies globally (as of now). Need to provide answer. Should consider current data (as of 2025). Top grossing films include: Avatar (2009) - James Cameron; Avengers: Endgame (2019) - Anthony and Joe Russo; Avatar: The Way of Water (2022) - James Cameron; Titanic (1997) - James Cameron; Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015) - J.J. Abrams. However sometimes top 5 may include: Avengers: Infinity War? Actually ranking changes. As of 2025, the top 5 globally: 1 Avatar, 2 Avengers: Endgame, 3 Avatar: The Way of Water, 4 Titanic, 5 Star Wars: The Force Awakens. So directors: James Cameron, Anthony and Joe Russo, James Cameron, James Cameron, J.J. Abrams. Could note co-directors for Russo brothers. Provide concise answer.

content:
**Directors of the current top‑5 highest‑grossing films worldwide (as of 2025)**  

| Rank | Film (release year) | Director(s) |
|------|----------------------|-------------|
| 1 | *Avatar* (2009) | **James Cameron** |
| 2 | *Avengers: Endgame* (2019) | **Anthony Russo & Joe Russo** (the Russo brothers) |
| 3 | *Avatar: The Way of Water* (2022) | **James Cameron** |
| 4 | *Titanic* (1997) | **James Cameron** |
| 5 | *Star Wars: The Force Awakens* (2015) | **J. J. Abrams** |

So the directors are **James Cameron**, the **Russo brothers (Anthony and Joe)**, and **J. J. Abrams**.
